body: Every pre-read protocol at a fixed private history has such a no-read kernel, proving completeness in this interface. The dualpi is a least-favorable COST distribution; zeros inpi do not delete all-X exactness constraints. Rectangular/singular/zero-entry channels are allowed. Ordinary LP, Blackwell/subchannel packing and residual sampling are credited rather than invented. Raw disclosure is not one physical bit;L-service/calibration/storage/fair randomness are extra.
